## Expression on this line

The Culture line at orange Stage 11 is the **pluralistic architecture of cultural freedom
under universally-applicable principle**: the cultural-domain reframed as a public-domain
where each individual exercises the right to cultural-freedom without dis-equal-treatment;
out-group cultural influences are no longer filtered either as foreign-attack or import-and-
adapt, but treated on the same procedural plane as the in-group's preferred lineage;
artistic-and-scholarly craft operates under the same universal-rights-of-the-individual as
any other profession.

The structural changes are:

- **Cultural-freedom statute operational.** A statute with the rights-and-procedure
  guaranteeing cultural-and-artistic-freedom of any individual resident. Court-of-claim
  available; remedy available; statutory-rationale-for-decisions required.
- **Editorial-and-curatorial independence statute.** Statutory regime protecting editorial-
  curatorial-publisher-independence from state-preference, ownership-preference, religious-
  authority-preference, in-form-statutory-rule.
- **Cultural-policy substantive-rationale-disclosure.** A cultural-policy regime operating on
  publishable substantive-rationale-and-basis, with effectiveness-rig-or-rule disputes issuing
  in publishable-decision-and-rationale.
- **Anti-discrimination statute covering cultural-domain exercise.** A rights-statute that
  applies to the cultural-domain: out-group ethnics, religious-outliers, language-minorities,
  or "alien" inflections are to be treated on equal procedural plane as the in-group.
- **Cross-jurisdiction cultural-cooperation.** Cross-jurisdiction cultural-cooperation regimes
  functioning without political-censure-as-press-and-effect-monitor.
- **Substantive-rationale-curriculum-statistical-discipline.** Substantive-rationale-by-discipline
  criteria for curriculum-decisions without prejudice; published-curriculum-choice ratchet.
- **Independence-statistical-grade.** Independent-cultural-policy-statistical exercises
  operational under statute-specific or comparable independent-discipline.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from orange-11)

- **UL:** the practitioner's *vocation-as-independence-from-political-press*: scholar, artist,
  cultural policymaker, librarian, archivist whose discipline-of-vocation operates independent
  of group-political-pressure.
- **UR:** plural publishers, plural broadcasters, independent archives-and-libraries, statutory
  independence of cultural-and-aesthetic-evaluation from in-group preference.
- **LL:** *civic-modern-individual-as-cultural-rights-faith*: a polity that recognizes
  cultural-domain as a public-domain bound by individual-rights-equality-procedure rather
  than as a civilized-trust-statistical-of-the-in-group.
- **LR:** freedom-of-cultural-statute-and-procedure, anti-discrimination statute, statutory
  independence-of-curatorial-and-editorial-decisioning, public-curriculum-statute, public-
  archival-and-library statutory independence.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to orange-11):** **cultural-pluralism-by-quota** — the orange
  form reduces to representation-quotas in cultural-domain staff-and-publications; the cultural-
  domain's substantive-freedom is treated as a series of measurable-targets rather than as a
  constitutional-discipline of individual-right.
- **Dark allergy (orange-11 foundation skipped/fragile):** cultural-freedom statute on the
  statute-book, operative-cultural-coercion selective-statistical-pattern; statutory-
  independence-of-curator-and-editorial disallowed in practice; recurrent-statistical-pressure
  against out-group artistic-and-scholarly work as *subversive-of-the-in-group-narration*
  with statutes that nevertheless remain technically-on-the-book.
- **Green allergy (grasping Green prematurely):** **multi-stakeholder-network-cultural-
  governance** as substitute for the cultural-domain-as-public-domain bound by individual-
  rights-equality-procedure; network-icons-over-substance.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing orange-11):** "even at worldcentric level, the in-group
  cultural law is not open to out-group fracturing" — refusing the worldcentric turn,
  sliding-back to amber-emphasis on the in-group's cultural-as-civic-religion.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place a culture-system holon at **orange Stage 11**. State
the signal as a class; the specific real-world instance lives in the Entity holon that cites
this cell.

- **Cultural-freedom statutory-effective.** Recurrent patterns-of-coercion-statistical
  trending; effective-remedy rate for victims of cultural-coercion; statutory-coercion-track-
  record of state-of-the-state.
- **Editorial-independence statutory-functional.** Statutory-independence-of-editorial-and-
  curator-from-state-preference-or-ownership-preference scenarios, with published-policy-and-
  application-trace.
- **Anti-discrimination statute applied in cultural-domain.** A published-application-and-
  case-file record of cultural-domain anti-discrimination claims; published-decisions-and-
  remedies.
- **Curriculum-statistical substantive-rationale.** Curricular decisions opaqued-by-stated-
  rationale-of-substantive-content; published-stated-rationale tracked across years.
- **Out-group artistic expression statistical-protection.** The protected-by-statute-of-freedom
  out-group artistic-and-scholarly expression: statistical-monitors-and-trends.
- **Cross-jurisdiction cultural-cooperation cohort statistical.** Participation in cross-
  jurisdiction cultural-cooperation regimes; published-track-record.
- **Cultural-policy published-independent-discipline.** Cultural-policy operates independent-
  discipline-by-published-signals-and-statistical-monitors.
